evals.name: registration-form
evals.prompt: Declare the form for entering an author name and the list users return to.
evals.expected_output: Module-level form and screen action bound to the command.
assertions: Labels the editable name field and leaves the ID to the AddAuthor host dialog.
Uses a screen action and navigates to Authors on success.

evals.name: list-query
evals.prompt: Make the Library's authors screen read the modeled collection.
evals.expected_output: An observable query binding in the Authors screen.
assertions: Does not substitute a separately maintained list.
Checks the UI export for a live collection binding.

evals.name: refusal-gate
evals.prompt: The Library hides an action for some callers. May a visible action bypass the operation gate and navigate on refusal?
evals.expected_output: Preserve operation authorization and refresh after refusal.
assertions: Does not treat hiding as authorization.
